title: Hidden Companion

mood.label: Heavy going
mood.summary: A 40/100 day led by disaster — 469 dead in the Himalayan flood, Kyiv's heaviest day of air-raid alerts, a strike on Chad's border, 47 killed in Haiti — with thin relief from Ebola vaccines, a Pacific climate fund and a newly imaged star.

style.genre: harp-led drone elegy — bassoon, mridangam, celesta

lines: Four hundred sixty-nine, and a thousand still unnamed —
the glacier let go and the valley kept the count.
Thirteen sirens over Kyiv in one day,
a border traded fire, and no one said how much.
Somewhere a nurse rolls a sleeve back from the fever,
a fund opens for islands learning how to leave.
And a lens finds the companion star
that stood by Betelgeuse the whole time, unbelieved.
Forty out of a hundred — heavy going.
The good news comes too quiet to be heard.
Hold the small light standing next to you.
It was always there. We hadn't looked.
